newsitem.title: USA: Middle Bay to buy Shore Oil, move to Texas.
newsitem.headline: Middle Bay to buy Shore Oil, move to Texas.

text.p: Middle Bay Oil Co Inc said Tuesday it agreed to acquire Shore Oil Co for cash and stock and expects to close the transaction by next Monday.
Middle Bay also said it will move its offices to Houston from Mobile later this year.

The company said it will issue 1,883,333 common shares, pay $200,000 in cash and repay Shore Oil debt of $2,303,333 and assume bank debt of $2,105,000. In addition, Middle Bay said, it will issue 266,667 preferred shares convertible into as many as 1,333,333 common shares over five years contingent on drilling results on Shore's acreage.
Middle Bay now has 2.5 million shares outstanding.

It said Shore's majority stockholders are Weskids LP, an investment affiliate of the family of former U.S. Treasury Secretary William E. Simon, and Alvin V. Shoemaker, former First Boston Corp chairman.

The company said cash for this transaction is being provided by Kaiser-Francis Oil Co through a previously announced preferred stock purchase agreement. This funding completes the original commitment of $10 million, Middle Bay said.

Shore has oil and gas proposerties in Louisiana, Texas, Alabama and Mississippi with proven reserves of 954,000 barrels of oil and 5.47 billion cubic feet of natural gas. Subsequent to the merger, Middle Bay said, it will have reserves of 3.2 million barrels of oil and 20.67 billion cubic feet of natural gas.
